description_en: Retrieves a list of snapshots. Each snapshot represents a point-in-time backup that can be used to restore a new instance with its full data
description_zh: 该接口用于查询备份数据列表。一份备份是对实例截止快照时间的全量数据快照，可以通过新购实例完全恢复原来的数据
kebab_example: aliyun hologram list-backup-data --instance-id hgprecn-cn-wwoxxxxx --backup-type redundant --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListBackupData

parameters.help_en: The backup type, used to filter snapshots. If you leave this parameter empty, all snapshots are returned
parameters.help_zh: 备份类型。根据类型过滤特定的备份数据，为空则返回所有备份数据
parameters.name: backup_type
